finalText:
**1291 spots across 94 files.** About 1080 are safe to rename.

Four places must keep `account_id`:
1. `docs/openapi.yaml`. Public names. Renaming breaks every client.
2. `migrations/`. Already run in production.
3. `vendor/reporting-sdk`. Regenerated. Edits vanish.
4. SQL text in `repo/` files. Also the map in `lib/serialize.js`. Both name the real column.
